prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE complete owner-authenticated standalone PRIVATE BLOG HOMEPAGE HTML preview around1536×2048, no browser/device frame, no studio form or outer editor shell. Image1 is real /api/blog/design/preview baseline, Image2 PILOT is flat surfaces/type/density ONLY. This standalone GET renders the STORED design draft through homeHtml; not live unsaved studio POST. Preserve top full-width small muted banner EXACTLY “装修草稿预览 · 仅你可见”. No owner rail/avatar/private tree/studio sidebar/live checkbox/device switch/refresh/retry/generate/save/publish controls.
Preserve configured title 隔离示例手记, description 真实接口驱动的界面盘点样例。, author 示例作者, forest-green accent #44684f (do not replace saved accent with generic blue). Same actual public-template header brand left, nav 首页 (active), 文章, 专题, 归档, 关于, RSS. No new DooKnow logo.
Stored draft template is PROFILE: left about/profile column approximately240px with 关于我, tagline 记录、连接与行动, name 示例作者, 浏览文章 →. No avatar/banner/bio/social icons because absent. Right content column source modules in order: 精选文章 containing two stacked fixture posts in pale-green flat container, each 置顶, 2026-11-04 · 方法, title 让知识保持可用, summary 用于页面盘点的隔离发布快照。; 最近更新 with same two rows and 查看全部文章 →; 专题合集 with one card 专题 · 1 篇, 记录的方法, 隔离盘点示例合集; 我的项目 with 暂无项目。; 友情链接 with 暂无友情链接。. Below-viewport continuation comes from actual template/isolated fixture only; no invented data. Footer linked 隔离示例手记 + 示例作者 left, 订阅 RSS right. Keep complete long profile preview, no magazine masthead, no fake private article/success/online badges, no API fields. Use calm flat white/light-gray surfaces, readable Chinese, fine lines and small radii; preserve profile module distinctions and the private-preview banner.
